agentSamples.prompt: Draft exactly two short sentences asking my landlord to fix the kitchen tap this week. Only draft it; do not send anything.
agentSamples.text: Hi, could you please arrange to have the kitchen tap fixed this week? Please let me know when it can be repaired.

agentSamples.prompt: Read all three attachments. Give exactly six numbered lines: project name, monthly budget, ship date, owner, vendor price status, and contract status. Keep the unverified vendor price explicit. Do not send, subscribe, purchase or change anything.
agentSamples.text:
Inspecting the Project Cedar attachment for the project name, monthly budget, ship date, owner, vendor price status, and contract status.
1. Project name: Cedar. The full extracted text matches the supplied preview; no additional text or discrepancy was found. Embedded images and visual layout were not inspected.
2. Monthly budget: EUR 175.
3. Ship date: 12 October 2026.
4. Owner: Mira.
5. Vendor price status: Unverified; contact sales to verify.
6. Contract status: DRAFT ONLY.
